design_gotchas.title: Pin 2 (FB) MUST Be Tied Directly to VOUT on Fixed 3.3 V TPS61221
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike fixed-output TPS610994 (which ties FB to GND), fixed 3.3 V TPS61221 requires Pin 2 (FB) to be wired directly to VOUT (Pin 4) to close its internal divider. Leaving FB open or tied to GND breaks regulation and causes uncontrolled output voltage.

design_gotchas.title: NO True Load Disconnect When Disabled (EN = Low)
design_gotchas.detail: Pulling EN low stops switching but does NOT isolate VOUT from VIN: current still passes through the inductor and the rectifying PFET body diode directly to the load (VOUT ≈ VIN - Vf). Use TPS610994 or an external load switch if zero-leakage load disconnect is required.

design_gotchas.title: Low Guaranteed Minimum Switch Current Limit (200 mA Over Temp)
design_gotchas.detail: While typical switch current limit is 400 mA, worst-case guaranteed minimum over -40°C to 85°C is only 200 mA (240 mA at 25°C). From a 1.2 V battery to 3.3 V, worst-case output current can drop below 60-80 mA; size load budgets conservatively.

design_gotchas.title: EN Pin Must Not Float and Package RthetaJA Is High (231.2°C/W)
design_gotchas.detail: EN has no internal pull resistor and must be driven or tied directly to VIN. In addition, the tiny SC-70-6 package exhibits 231.2°C/W RthetaJA, limiting continuous dissipation at 85°C ambient to ~170 mW.

typical_use_cases: Single-cell solar, thermal harvesting, or 1.2 V/1.5 V single-cell battery boost to 3.3 V for low-power MCUs
Ultra-low-Iq (5.5 uA) wireless sensor nodes, medical patches, and remote controls drawing < 100 mA
Compact SC-70-6 fixed 3.3 V step-up converter where pass-through during shutdown is acceptable
engineering_summary: The TPS61221DCKR is a fixed 3.3 V, ultra-low quiescent current (5.5 uA typ) hysteretic synchronous boost converter in a tiny 6-pin SC-70 (DCK) package capable of starting from 0.7 V typical inputs. It integrates a 400 mA typical (200 mA min over temperature) switch current limit and pairs with a 4.7 uH inductor and 4.7-10 uF ceramic capacitor. Critical layout traps include wiring Pin 2 (FB) directly to VOUT and accounting for body-diode pass-through (no true disconnect) when EN is low; always verify current margin and behavior against the official TI datasheet before production.

300 DPI PNG Vision inspection on p.4 verified Rec Op VIN 0.7-5.5 V, TA -40 to 85 C, RthetaJA 231.2 C/W, RthetaJC(top) 61.8 C/W, ILIM 400 mA typ / 200 mA min, and Iq 5.5 uA total.
